author: Splades
body:
The two accounts are: Anuj and wtap

Basically these two accounts were banned a long time ago, one of them was a reasonable ban and another one wasn't. I will now explain how both of these accounts were banned.

Anuj: About a year and a half ago, DaGoldBrick got this account banned falsely for Kill Aura. He wasn't trying to get banned either by headtwitching or anything and he was just playing. He was on this account while I was on my main and we were in the same game when he got banned.

I don't see why this account should still be banned: A: It was a false ban. B: He was appealed after on his main so this account should be unbanned aswell.

Link to video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=J0-mbcL2qbQ

wtap: This one may be a little hard to believe but while I was letting my friend play, he downloaded the Kryptonite client which has 7 block Kill Aura and started flying around to destroy monuments. I know this one is my fault since my account is MY RESPONSIBILITY but yeah that's all there is really to it.

I'm sorry this has happened and since then I have never let any friends play while I'm doing something else, I've told them that if they want to play they can get their own accounts.
